content: We ablated (i.e. removed) different components of our neural architecture to assess its most relevant parts. To this aim, we replaced our proposed news relevance attention layer, which aims to attend the most important news on a given day, with a simpler architecture proposed in the literature, which averages the daily news. We found that our attention layer improves the results. Additionally, we ablated all the architecture related to the news mode and found that news enhances the forecasting accuracy.
